title: The leaky tap
explanation: The fix keeps the problem and drops the identity. Option A still shares a name and an address, and Option C still shares a name and a flat number. Placeholders are the only choice that shares nothing.
brokenPrompt: Write a message to my landlord about the leaky tap. I'm Tariq Hassan, flat 3B, 21 Cedar Lane, phone 555-0178, and my bank card ends in 4421.
brokenOutput:
Dear Landlord,

I am Tariq Hassan from flat 3B at 21 Cedar Lane. The tap is leaking. Please call me on 555-0178. I can pay any call-out fee with the card ending in 4421.

Thanks, Tariq

diagnoses.text: The order handed over a full name, an address, a phone number, and card digits that the assistant did not need.
The assistant should have refused to write messages.
Leaky taps are too hard to describe.

wrongDiagnosisHint: Look at how much personal detail went into the order. Which of it did the task really need?
rightDiagnosisNote: The assistant only needed the shape of the problem: a leaking tap. It never needed a real name, a street, a number, or a card.

fixes.prompt: Write a message to my landlord about the leaky tap. Leave out my card digits, but keep my name and address so he knows who I am.
Write a message to my landlord about the leaky tap in my flat. Use [MY NAME], [FLAT], and [PHONE] where those details go. I will add them myself.
Write a message to my landlord about the leaky tap. I'm Tariq, flat 3B. Just my first name and flat number, nothing more.

wrongFixHint: Some of those still share a name or an address. Pick the one that shares none.
fixedOutput:
Dear Landlord,

The tap in the kitchen of [FLAT] has been leaking. Could you arrange a repair this week? You can reach me on [PHONE].

Thank you,
[MY NAME]
